summary: Serve current first frames and live updates for uncaptured subscriptions in recorded scenario worlds

replay.detail: No daemon claim replay or recovery changes. Scenario replay distinguishes captured subscribe commands from new subscriptions: captured commands retain exact wire boundaries, while new subscriptions snapshot folded state and follow timeline events without duplicate recorded frames.

schema.detail: No public wire schema or committed fixture changes. Imported scenario transport metadata additionally retains captured subscribe commands and clock offsets.

compatibility.detail: Conversation and collection frame shapes remain unchanged. Pending conversations receive empty replacement snapshots; present conversations receive their current folded page. Catalog onboarding already uses folded-state replay and now has exact thread-creation boundary coverage.

downtime.detail: No service deployment or interruption required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or recovery restrictions.
